input.behavior_to_protect: The resolved tags list must not alias the base layer's list; mutating the result must not change the base layer.

available_values.mutate_test: append c to result, base layer tags must still equal [a]

description: Write one regression scenario where a base layer sets tags=["a"] and an override layer adds tags=["b"]; the resolved tags must not alias the base list, so mutating the result must not change the base layer. The scenario must fail a mutant that reuses the base list reference.
requirements: Return one JSON test scenario using only the supplied values. It must make the correct behavior pass and the named mutant fail.
